title: FH-SWF_SG at GermEval 2021: Using Transformer-Based Language Models to Identify Toxic, Engaging, & Fact-Claiming Comments
reasoning: The paper describes a system submission for the GermEval 2021 shared task, focusing on the technical performance (F1-scores) of fine-tuned transformer models for classifying toxicity, engagement, and fact-claiming. It does not engage in evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
